items.title: Sharp degeneration bound for the spectral sequence of locally free isometric abelian Lie group actions
items.author: Pawel Razny
items.source_version: Official SIGMA22(2026),072, publisher native TeX retrieved2026-10-13; counterpart arXiv2506.12422
items.difficulty_reason: The author bounds every higher spectral-sequence differential using a rank-adapted splitting of curvature classes and an explicit staircase computation. A separate family of torus bundles realizes the sharp page bound by tracing a surviving class and proving its next differential is nonzero. The bound and its sharpness are kept as one research problem; the previously counted invariant-form proposition is supporting context only.
